title: pg-claude-control session end file
description: One file <controlStateDir>/ends/<session-id>.<unix-ms>.json per session.end, written through a temporary name and mv so a reader never sees a torn file.

reason.description: prompt_input_exit: /exit, Ctrl-D, run exit (measured); clear: /clear (measured); other: SIGTERM and SIGHUP (measured); resume and logout are not yet measured.

timeMs.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the file was written; equals the <unix-ms> in the file name.
